item.title: Carnap – A formal logic framework for Haskell
item.description:
📝 io A formal logic framework for Haskell Background Carnap is a free and open software framework written in Haskell for teaching and studying formal logic. Carnap powers logic courses at dozens of colleges and universities around the world. If you're just curious about Carnap, you can find some general information on our about page.
🔗 Read more: https://carnap.io/
